title: Litany of St. Rita
description: A responsive litany to St. Rita, intercessor in difficult and impossible cases.
body:
[[heading]]LITANY OF ST. RITA OF CASCIA[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Christ, have mercy,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]God the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]God the Holy Spirit,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Holy Trinity, one God,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Mary Immaculate, Mother of God[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Mary, Mother and comforter of those who suffer[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Mary, Queen of all Saints[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Mary, beloved intercessor of St. Rita[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, gift from Heaven:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, our powerful intercessor:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, endowed with glory:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, admired from your childhood:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, lover of solitude:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, model of purity of heart:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, model of all gentleness:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, model of a good wife:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, excellent model of a devoted mother:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, model of true forgiveness:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, living model of self-denial:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, mirror of religious life:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, mirror of obedience:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, admirable in patience:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, hero of self-sacrifice:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, witness in doing penance:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, holy widow:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, generous to the poor:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, generous to the poor:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, zealous in answering the holy call:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, miraculously admitted into the convent:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, fragrance of myrrh:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, garden of every virtue:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, beloved of Jesus Crucified:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, wounded by a thorn on your forehead:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, beloved daughter of the Virgin Mary:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, thirsty for Divine Love:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, clothed with glory:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, pearl of Heaven:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, glory of the Order of St. Augustine:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, precious treasure of Umbria:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, powerful in holiness:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, relief of those in distress:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, comforter of those who suffer:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, anchor of salvation:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, intercessor for the sick:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, intercessor in impossible cases:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, refuge of those in danger:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, powerful help for all:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, wonder of the world:[[/plain]]

[[plain]]St. Rita, received joyfully into Heaven:[[/plain]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, spare us, O Lord[[/lamb]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, graciously hear us, O Lord[[/lamb]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world, have mercy on us[[/lamb]]

[[plain]]V: You have marked, O Lord, your servant Rita[[/plain]]

[[response]]R: With the seal of love and suffering[[/response]]

[[heading]]LET US PRAY:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O God, who in your unfailing goodness have been pleased to hear the intercession of your servant Rita, grant us through her intercession those things that are impossible by human strength. Have mercy on us who suffer, and help all who do not believe in you to know that you are the reward of the humble, the comforter of all who are afraid, and the strength of the weak. We ask this through Christ our Lord. Amen[[/plain]]

description: A litany asking the Blessed Virgin Mary, Holy Mother of God, to intercede for us.

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Father of Heaven, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Spirit, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, one God, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Holy Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mother of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Virgin, greatest of virgins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of Christ,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of divine grace,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most holy Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother most pure,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother without stain,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother without sin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Beloved Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Admirable Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of good counsel,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of the Creator,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of the Redeemer,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Virgin most orderly,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Virgin most honorable,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Virgin most praised,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Virgin most powerful,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Virgin most merciful,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Faithful Virgin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Seat of justice,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Seat of wisdom,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Cause of our joy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Vessel of grace,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Vessel of honor,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Excellent vessel of devotion,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mystical rose,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Tower of David,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Tower of ivory,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]House of gold,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Ark of the Covenant,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Gate of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Morning Star,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Health of the sick,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Refuge of sinners,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Comforter of the afflicted,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Queen of Patriarchs,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of Prophets,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of Apostles,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of Martyrs,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of Confessors,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of Virgins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of all Saints,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen conceived without original sin,[[/plain]]

title: Litany of Divine Mercy
description: A litany responding to the mercy of God with trust and prayer.
body:
[[heading]]LITANY OF DIVINE MERCY[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy - Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy - Christ, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy - Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, hear us - Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Father of Heaven - have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world - have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Spirit - have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, one God - have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: We trust in you[[/response]]

[[plain]]Divine Mercy, highest attribute of our Creator.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, summit of the perfection of our Savior.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, immeasurable love of the Sanctifying Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, unfathomable mystery of the Holy Trinity.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, sign of the supreme power of Almighty God.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, revealed in the creation of the angelic spirits in Heaven.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which created us and commanded us to exist from nothing.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which grants us immortal life.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which shields us from the punishment we deserve.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which raises us from the hardship, weakness, and pain of our sins.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which makes us righteous in the Word made Man.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which overflows from the wounds of Christ.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which flows from within the Sacred Heart of Jesus.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which gave us the Blessed Virgin Mary as Mother of Mercy.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, shown in the founding of the Catholic Church.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, found in the mysteries of the Holy Sacraments.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, given to all humanity through the Sacraments of Baptism and Penance.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, given in the Sacraments of the Eucharist and Holy Orders.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, shown to us when it calls and leads us into sanctifying the righteous.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, fulfilled in the perfection of holy people.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, fountain of health for the sick and all who suffer.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, comfort of all those with sorrowful hearts.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, hope of souls troubled by despair.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, constant companion everywhere for all people.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, which hastens to bring us its graces.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, peace of those who are dying.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, refreshment and comfort of the faithful departed in purgatory.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, heavenly joy for all the saints.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, crown of all the saints.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Divine Mercy, unfailing fountain of miracles.[[/plain]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who showed us your great mercy by redeeming the world through your holy cross, spare us, O Lord.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who offers yourself to us with love and mercy in every celebration of the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass, graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world through your infinite mercy, have mercy on us.[[/lamb]]

[[plain]]Leader: Lord, have mercy.[[/plain]]
[[response]]All: Christ, have mercy, Lord, have mercy.[[/response]]
[[plain]]Leader: The tender mercies of the Lord are over all his works.[[/plain]]
[[response]]All: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever.[[/response]]

[[heading]]Let us pray:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O God of infinite mercy, whose treasures of goodness and love have no limit, we beg you to look upon your people here on earth and increase your mercy upon us again and again, so that it may help us never to despair, no matter how great the trials we meet, but always to turn toward and keep your commandments with hope and fulfill your holy will, which is mercy itself. We ask this through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, King of Peace and Mercy, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, together showing us mercy, forever and ever. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of the Holy Spirit
description: A litany invoking the Holy Spirit for sanctification, wisdom, and grace.
body:
[[heading]]The Litany of the Holy Spirit[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Father all powerful,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Promise of God the Father,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Ray of heavenly light,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Author of all good,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Source of Heavenly water,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Consuming Fire,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Ardent Charity,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spiritual Unction,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of love and truth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of wisdom and understanding,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of counsel and fortitude,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of knowledge and piety,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of the fear of the Lord,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of grace and prayer,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of peace and meekness,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of modesty and innocence,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, the Comforter,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, the Sanctifier,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, Who governest the Church,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Gift of God the Most High,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit Who fillest the universe,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Spirit of the adoption of the children of God,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Save us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Jesus, Eternal Son of the Father, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Sanctify us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Spirit of the Father and the Son, boundless Life of both,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Hear us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Holy Trinity,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Enter our hearts[[/response]]

[[plain]]Holy Spirit, Who proceedest from the Father and the Son,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, Who art equal to the Father and the Son,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Holy Spirit, inspire us with horror of sin.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, come and renew the face of the earth.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, shed Thy light into our souls.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, engrave Thy law in our hearts.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, inflame us with the flame of Thy love.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, open to us the treasures of Thy graces.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, teach us to pray well.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, enlighten us with Thy Heavenly inspirations.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, lead us in the way of salvation.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, grant us the only necessary knowledge.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, inspire in us the practice of good.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, grant us the merits of all virtues.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, make us persevere in justice.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Spirit, be our everlasting reward.[[/plain]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Send us Thy Holy Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Pour down into our souls the gifts of the Holy Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Grant us the Spirit of wisdom and piety.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]V. Come, Holy Spirit! Fill the hearts of Thy faithful,[[/plain]]
[[response]]R. And enkindle in them the fire of Thy love.[[/response]]

[[heading]]Let Us Pray.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Grant, O merciful Father, that Thy Divine Spirit may enlighten, inflame and purify us, that He may penetrate us with His heavenly dew and make us fruitful in good works, through Our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who with Thee, in the unity of the same Spirit, liveth and reigneth forever and ever. R. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany to the Sacred Head of Jesus
description: A litany honoring the Sacred Head of Jesus and the wisdom of Christ.
body:
[[heading]]Litany to the Sacred Head of Jesus[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, Have Mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, Have Mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord Have Mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Jesus, Graciously Hear us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have Mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]God the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the World,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Ghost,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Guide us in All our Ways[[/response]]

[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Formed by the Holy Ghost in the Womb of the Virgin Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Substantially United to the Word of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Temple of Divine Wisdom,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Center of Eternal Light,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Tabernacle of Divine Knowledge,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Safeguard Against Error,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Sunshine of Heaven and Earth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Treasure of Science and Pledge of Faith,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Radiant With Beauty and Justice and Love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Full of Grace and Truth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Living Witness of Humility,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Reflecting the Infinite Majesty of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Center of the Universe,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Object of the Father's Joyous Satisfaction,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Upon Which the Holy Ghost Rested,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Around Which the Glory of Mt. Tabor Shown,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Had No Place on Earth on Which to Rest,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Whom the Fragrant Anointing of Magdalen Consoled,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Bathed With the Sweat of Blood in Gethsemane,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Wept for our Sins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Crowned with Thorns,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Outraged by the Indignities of the Passion,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Consoled by the Loving Gesture of Veronica,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Bowed to Earth Which was Redeemed at the Moment of Death on the Calvary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Light of Every Being Born on Earth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Our Guide and our Hope,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Knows All our Needs,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Gives us All Graces,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, That Governs All the Motions of the Sacred Heart,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Whom we Wish to Adore and Make Known Throughout the World,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Knows All the Secrets of Our Hearts,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Who Enraptures Angels and the Saints,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sacred Head of Jesus, Whom One Day we Hope to Behold Unveiled Forever,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Jesus, we Adore Thy Sacred Head; we Surrender Utterly to All the Decrees of Thine Infinite Wisdom.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of St. Aloysius Gonzaga
description: A litany asking the intercession of St. Aloysius Gonzaga.
body:
[[heading]]The Litany of St. Aloysius Gonzaga[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]God, the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Ghost,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, One God,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Holy Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mother of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Virgin of virgins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Aloysius Gonzaga,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Beloved child of Christ,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]The delight of the Blessed Virgin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most chaste youth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Angelic youth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most humble youth,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Model of young students,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Despiser of riches,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Enemy of vanities,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Scorner of honors,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Honor of princes,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Jewel of the nobility,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Flower of innocence,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Ornament of the religious state,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mirror of mortification,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mirror of perfect obedience,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lover of angelical poverty,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most affectionately devout,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most zealous observer of rules,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Most desirous of the salvation of souls,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Perpetual adorer of the Holy Eucharist,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Particular client of Saint Ignatius,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Spare us, O Lord[[/response]]

[[plain]]Be merciful,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Hear us, O Lord[[/response]]

[[plain]]Be merciful,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: O Lord, deliver us[[/response]]

[[plain]]From the concupiscence of the eyes,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From the concupiscence of the flesh,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From the pride of life,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Through the merits and intercession of Saint Aloysius,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Through his angelical purity,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Through his sanctity and glory,[[/plain]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Spare us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]V. Pray for us, Saint Aloysius,[[/plain]]
[[response]]R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.[[/response]]

[[heading]]Let Us Pray.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O God, distributor of heavenly gifts, Who united in the angelic youth, Aloysius, wonderful innocence of life to an equal severity of penance, grant, through his merits and prayers, that we who have not followed the example of his innocence may imitate his practice of penance, through Our Lord Jesus Christ. R. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of St. Jude Thaddeus
description: A litany asking the intercession of St. Jude Thaddeus, helper of the hopeless.
body:
[[heading]]The Litany of St. Jude Thaddeus[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]God the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Ghost,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, One God,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Saint Jude, relative of Jesus and Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, deemed worthy while on earth to see Jesus and Mary and to enjoy their company,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, raised to the dignity of an Apostle,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who hadst the honor of beholding thy Divine Master humble Himself to wash thy feet,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who at the Last Supper didst receive the Holy Eucharist from the hands of Jesus,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who after the profound grief which the death of thy beloved Master caused thee, hadst the consolation of beholding Him risen from the dead, and of assisting at His glorious Ascension,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who wast filled with the Holy Ghost on the day of Pentecost,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst preach the Gospel in Persia,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst convert many people to the Faith,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst perform wonderful miracles in the power of the Holy Ghost,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst restore an idolatrous king to health of both soul and body,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst impose silence on demons and didst confound their oracles,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst foretell to a weak prince an honorable peace with his powerful enemy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst take from deadly serpents the power of injuring man,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who, disregarding the threats of the impious, didst courageously preach the doctrine of Christ,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, who didst gloriously suffer martyrdom for the love of thy Divine Master,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: With confidence we invoke thee[[/response]]

[[plain]]Blessed Apostle,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Blessed Apostle,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Blessed Apostle,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Aid me in my distress[[/response]]

[[plain]]St. Jude, help of the hopeless,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, help of the hopeless,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]St. Jude, help of the hopeless,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: We beseech thee, hear us[[/response]]

[[plain]]That by thy intercession, both priests and people of the Church may obtain an ardent zeal for the Faith of Jesus Christ,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That thou wouldst defend our Sovereign Pontiff and obtain peace and unity for the Holy Church,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That all heathens and unbelievers may be converted to the True Faith,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That faith, hope and charity may increase in our hearts,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That we may be delivered from all evil thoughts and from all the snares of the devil,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That thou wouldst vouchsafe to aid and protect all those who honor thee,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That thou wouldst preserve us from all sin and from all occasions of sin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That thou wouldst defend us at the hour of death against the fury of the devil and of his evil spirits,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Pray for us[[/response]]

[[plain]]That before death we may expiate all our sins by sincere repentance and the worthy reception of the holy Sacraments,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That we may appease the Divine Justice and obtain a favorable judgment,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, source of all consolation,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, our life and resurrection,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, our peace and reconciliation,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, victim for sinners,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, salvation of those who hope in Thee,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, hope of those who die in Thee,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Heart of Jesus, delight of all the Saints,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]

[[plain]]V. Jesus, meek and humble of Heart,[[/plain]]
[[response]]R. Make our hearts like unto Thine.[[/response]]

[[heading]]LET US PRAY.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O Almighty and Eternal God, look upon the Heart of Thy most beloved Son, and upon the honour and satisfaction which He hath offered unto Thee on behalf of sinners; and being well pleased, grant pardon to those who implore Thy mercy, through the same Thy Son Jesus Christ, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of the Holy Face of Jesus
description: A litany honoring the Holy Face of Jesus, adored from Bethlehem to Calvary.
body:
[[plain]]Litany of the Holy Face of Jesus[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord Jesus, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord Jesus, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]God, the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Spirit,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, One God,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which took Flesh and became Man,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which shone forth in the manger of Bethlehem,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, adored by the Virgin Mother Mary in the cave,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, adored by Saint Joseph in the cave,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, adored by the Angels,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, adored by the Shepherds,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which has mercy on sinners,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which wept tears of Blood during Thy Passion,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, transfigured and shining on Mount Tabor,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, bathed in Blood in the Garden of Gethsemane,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, comforted by an Angel in Thine agony,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, spat upon one hundred and eighty times,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, comforted by Veronica,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, so greatly despised,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, smitten with blows and buffeted,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, dimmed by most bitter suffering,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, wounded by the piercing of thorns,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, upon which the Angels desire to gaze,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which is the eternal light,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, the joy of the Angels,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which shines upon us all,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, the first chamber of heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, looking upon us with goodness and mercy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, eternal name,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Face of Jesus, which is most meek,[[/plain]]

[[response]]Response: Have mercy on us[[/response]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Spare us, O Lord.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Have mercy on us.[[/lamb]]

[[heading]]LET US PRAY.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O God, who didst give Thine only-begotten Son to be the Savior of all mankind, we beseech Thee to accept the sacrifice of His most bitter passion; look not upon our sins, but only upon the most amiable Face of Thine only-begotten Son. We adore the Holy Face of our Lord Jesus Christ, our Savior, whose love is infinite and whose mercy is beyond measure. May He Himself grant us the forgiveness of our sins, and may we comfort His Holy Face by living holily and witnessing to our faith through love, without fear. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O Holy Face, from which blood flowed, O Holy Face of the Lord Jesus, be adored forever. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany for the Souls in Purgatory
description: A litany interceding for the souls of the faithful departed in purgatory.
body:
[[heading]]LITANY FOR THE SOULS IN PURGATORY[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Jesus, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Jesus, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]God, the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Spirit,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, One God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Have mercy on the souls of the faithful departed.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Holy Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mother of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Michael,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Gabriel,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Angels and Archangels,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint John the Baptist,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Joseph,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Patriarchs and Prophets,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Peter,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Paul,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint John,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Apostles and Evangelists,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Stephen,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Lawrence,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Martyrs,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Gregory,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Ambrose,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Bishops and Confessors,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Mary Magdalene,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Saint Catherine,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Holy Virgins and Widows,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]All ye Saints of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Pray for the souls of the faithful departed.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Be merciful to them,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Deliver them, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Be merciful to them,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From all scars of sin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Deliver them, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From Thy wrath,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From the flames of fire,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]From the region of the shadow of death,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]By Thy Conception without original sin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy Nativity,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy Holy Name,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By the multitude of Thy meekness and mercy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy bitter passion,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy most Holy Wounds,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy Precious Blood,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]By Thy shameful death, by which Thou didst destroy our death,[[/plain]]

[[plain]]We sinners,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O Thou who didst forgive the sinful woman and didst listen to the prayer of the good thief, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That Thou wouldst be pleased to release our deceased parents, relations, and benefactors from the bonds of sin and its punishment, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That Thou wouldst be pleased to hasten the day of visiting Thy faithful who are bound in the state of suffering, and bring them into the city of eternal peace, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That Thou wouldst be pleased to shorten their time of expiation for their sins and graciously receive them into the holy sanctuary, wherein nothing defiled can ever enter, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That through the prayers and sacrifices of Thy Church, and even by the sacrifice of supreme value of Thy Holy Altar, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That Thou wouldst be pleased to receive them into the tabernacle of rest and the reward of their hope, together with everlasting bliss, in the presence of the Son of God, We beseech Thee, hear us.[[/plain]]

[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Grant them eternal rest.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Grant them eternal rest.[[/lamb]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, who takest away the sins of the world, Grant them eternal rest.[[/lamb]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray: Our Father . . .[[/plain]]
[[plain]]V/ Lead us not into temptation,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]R/ But deliver us from evil.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]V/ From the gates of hell,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]R/ Deliver their souls, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]V/ May they rest in peace,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]R/ Amen.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]V/ O Lord, hear my prayer,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]R/ And let my cry come unto Thee.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]Let us pray:[[/heading]]
[[plain]]O God, the Redeemer of all the faithful, grant to the souls of Thy departed servants the remission of all their sins, that through our pious supplications they may obtain the pardon which they have always desired. Through our Lord. Amen.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]O God, the giver of pardon and lover of human salvation, we implore Thy mercy on behalf of our brothers, relatives, and benefactors who have departed from this life, that through the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of all the saints, they may be received into the joys of Thine everlasting kingdom. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]O God, whose property is always to have mercy and to spare, we beseech Thee to look with favor upon the souls of Thy servants and grant them the remission of all their sins, so that, being delivered from the bonds of this life, they may be admitted into eternal life. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of Our Lady of Seven Sorrows
description: A litany honoring the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Sorrows, approved by Pope Pius VII.
body:
[[plain]]Litany of Our Lady of Seven Sorrows[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]God, the Father of heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Redeemer of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Ghost,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, One God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray for us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Holy Mary, Mother of God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Virgin of virgins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of the Crucified,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sorrowful Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mournful Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sighing Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Afflicted Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Forsaken Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Desolate Mother,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother most sad,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother set around with anguish,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother overwhelmed by grief,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother transfixed by a sword,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother crucified in thy heart,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother bereaved of thy Son,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sighing Dove,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mother of Dolors,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Fount of tears,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Sea of bitterness,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Field of tribulation,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mass of suffering,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Mirror of patience,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Rock of constancy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Remedy in perplexity,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Joy of the afflicted,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Ark of the desolate,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Refuge of the abandoned,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Shield of the oppressed,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Conqueror of the incredulous,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Solace of the wretched,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Medicine of the sick,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Help of the faint,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Strength of the weak,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Protectress of those who fight,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Haven of the shipwrecked,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Calmer of tempests,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Companion of the sorrowful,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Retreat of those who groan,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Terror of the treacherous,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Standard-bearer of the Martyrs,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Treasure of the Faithful,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Light of Confessors,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Pearl of Virgins,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Comfort of Widows,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Joy of all Saints,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Queen of thy Servants,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mary, who alone art unexampled,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Pray for us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray for us, most Sorrowful Virgin,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]LET US PRAY:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O God, in whose Passion, according to the prophecy of Simeon, a sword of grief pierced through the most sweet soul of Thy glorious Blessed Virgin Mother Mary: grant that we, who celebrate the memory of her Seven Sorrows, may obtain the happy effect of Thy Passion, Who lives and reigns world without end. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Litany of Reparation
description: A litany offering reparation to God for the sins of the world, especially sins against the Most Holy Sacrament.
body:
[[heading]]LITANY OF REPARATION[[/heading]]

[[plain]]For the sick, the suffering, and all who are dying this day, especially those who are not prepared to die.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYER FOR THE HOLY SOULS IN NEED:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Eternal Father, I offer Thee the Precious Blood of Thy beloved Son Jesus, in union with all the Masses said throughout the world this day, for all the Holy Souls in Purgatory, for sinners everywhere, for sinners in the universal Church, for those in my own home and within my family. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Lord, have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Christ, hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Christ, graciously hear us.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]God, the Father of Heaven,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Son, Mediator between God and men,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]God the Holy Ghost, Light of hearts,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Trinity, one and undivided,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]HOLY HOST OF REPARATION:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Holy Host, propitiation for the sins of the world,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Host, offered upon the Altar by us and for us,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Host, despised and neglected,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Host, outraged by the impiety and irreverence of men,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Host, forsaken and abandoned in Thy churches,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]have mercy on us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Be merciful unto us, spare us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Be merciful unto us, graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYERS OF REPARATION:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]For the deliberate profanation of this most sacred Sacrament,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For unworthy Communions,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For Christians who fail in reverence,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the conversations held in Thy holy churches,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the sins of sinners,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the profanation of the Sacrament of Love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the lukewarmness of Thy children,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the contempt of Thy loving invitation,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the unfaithfulness of those who call themselves Thy friends,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the failure to use Thy graces properly,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the abuse of Thy graces,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For infidelity,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For our tardiness in loving Thee,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For tepidity in Thy holy service,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For not being as devoted as we ought to be,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For our contempt of Thee,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For pride and hypocrisy,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For failure to fulfill our obligations,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For disobedience to Thy holy Will,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For setting a poor example,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For failure to correct our faults,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the grief Thou dost suffer through the loss of souls,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For waiting so long at the door of our hearts,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the agonies of Thy love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the tears of Thy love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the bonds of Thy love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]For the death of Thy love,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We offer Thee reparation, O Lord.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]CLOSING:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Save us, graciously hear us, O Lord, we beseech Thee hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]May Thy love be known unto us through Thy most Holy Sacrament, O Lord, we beseech Thee hear us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Vouchsafe to accept our reparation, offered with humble spirits, O Lord, we beseech Thee hear us.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Spare us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Graciously hear us, O Lord.[[/plain]]
[[lamb]]Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of the world,[[/lamb]]
[[plain]]Have mercy on us.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYER OF REPARATION:[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O Most Holy Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, I adore Thee profoundly and I offer Thee the Body, Blood, Soul, and Divinity of Jesus Christ present in all the Tabernacles of the world, in reparation for the outrages, sacrileges, and indifferences by which He is so greatly offended. Through the infinite merits of His Most Sacred Heart and by the Immaculate Heart of Mary, I beg of Thee the conversion of poor sinners. Amen.[[/plain]]
